patch.value: Train a history-prefix learner on the public tracker environment

PR 84 acceptance scored 107/214 on meta-validation versus the completed-majority baseline 211/214, and 198/385 on final-test versus 384/385. All candidates retained the zero-weight seed checkpoint because inner fits were refused. Add a bounded learner that actually reads the normalized history prefix, such as the existing LM adapter, on the sealed repository-split tracker environment.

Train only on training repositories; preserve inner-held-out, meta-validation and final-test boundaries, fixed pre-approved budgets and unchanged promotion gate; report majority baselines, prediction diversity and final-test scores; demonstrate statistically supported improvement or explicitly report a null result without weakening the gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: measure four candidate targets on training repositories only, freeze the selected task and split rules, then fit a bounded hashed prefix learner through the existing reserved process contract. Keep the 0.95 confidence, ten-sample, 0.01 effect gate and release disabled. Retain explicit fit, rejection, diversity, baseline and final-test evidence; verify behavioural reverts and both isolated release gates before opening the PR.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First real acceptance attempt aborted operationally before completing candidate scoring: checkpoint + completion receipt + mirrored NDJSON event consumed 4195 staging bytes, exceeding the unchanged 4096 allowance. Keep the refusal and original receipts. Quantise fitted parameters to four decimal places to fit the declared storage budget; do not enlarge any approval or statistical gate. Restart acceptance with this fixed numerical representation. No target or recipe was chosen from held-out scores.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The completed diagnostic run exposed a correctness bug, also caught by the synthetic acceptance regression: inner fitted and seed policies shared the recipe digest as their generation id, causing a self-comparison refusal. This run is invalid improvement evidence. Inner comparisons now use distinct checkpoint identities; outer comparisons retain recipe identities. Promotion confidence, sample and effect thresholds are unchanged. Rerun exactly the same target, cut, split, bounds and seed without tuning after seeing either outer holdout.

Local strict health reports a global pm-github/CLI version skew (pinned host 2026.10.13 versus extension host 2026.10.18); no-extensions storage authority passes.
